english:
At x5 Untold Greed or higher, you gain the following benefits:
• Elemental Pickups grant 15% Ability Energy to their respective Ability
• <arc Ionic Traces /> grant 2% Super Energy, 10% Grenade and Melee Energy, and 15% Class Energy
• <strand Strand Tangles /> deal 350% increased damage

Orbs of Power are unaffected.

Reaching Critical Health at x5 Untold Greed or higher consumes all stacks to spawn 4 Orbs of Power in front of you, each granting about 3.15% Super Energy.

Looking up or down does not change where the Orbs go, and allied Guardians can collect them too.

This bonus is disabled in the Crucible.

source.text:
4 Piece | Overflowing Coffers
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

While at x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Elemental Pickups grant +15% Ability Energy to their respective Ability.
Ionic Traces grant +2% Super Energy, +10% Grenade/Melee, and +15% Class Energy.
Strand Tangles deal 350% increased damage.
No effect on Orbs of Power, despite description.

Firesprites = 25% Grenade
Ionic Traces = 2% Super, 20% Grenade/Melee, 25% Class
Void Breaches = 25% Class
Stasis Shards = 36% Melee Energy

Upon reaching Critical Health while having x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Consumes ALL STACKS to spawn 4 Orbs of Power that each grant ~3.15% Super Energy.
The Orbs of Power are ejected in front of the user at high speeds, likely clipping inside walls.

Looking upwards/downwards does not affect where the Orbs go.
Allied Guardians get the Orbs, too.
